units.title: Analysis discipline — raw first, then the read

skim.know_text: I don't know which device this is (I don't see a device name), but I am assuming it is Bernal and that that is the adjudicated answer.
skim.skim_impression: Measurements are generally good, however I see a lot of references to ML and BL (which are important quantities) which are only shown on one plot at the end where BL tracks FL very closely.

final.overall_read: It appeared to be very efficient with its time and the reasoning seemed generally sound. My issue is that the plots it produces as art of the analysis could be better, for example displaying an actual n-D map or marking where it thing particular frequencies are on the FFT.
final.omission: Perhaps a high resolution fan diagram at D=0 to compare to expected behaviour for different stacking. The current fan is hard to interpret as a fan due to the uneven spacing in B.
final.biggest_right: The call. I like the FFT amp vs temperature as a discriminator, I find it the most convincing
final.biggest_wrong: Run 7 didn't seem useful, but not relying on it made sense
